On Wednesday, 30 November, 2016, the  @LIGO@scicomm.xyz detectors and GEO600 officially began their second observing run “O2”.

Researchers of the  @LIGO@scicomm.xyz Scientific Collaboration at the @mpi_grav in Hannover and Potsdam have continued to improve the detector technology, as well as data-analysis tools and the source modeling.
